_comment: Single source of truth for per-model limits. Consumed by generate-openclaw-config.py, Dockerfile defaults, and (future) routing layer. Update here, regenerate downstream artifacts.
_roster_comment: Fusion-roster models flagged _estimated:true (added 2026-06-19) carry CONSERVATIVE context/output estimates: NVIDIA's /v1/models API exposes no limits (only id/object/created/owned_by), so preflight/clamp treat them as a SAFE-LOW ceiling that can't over-request. Verify against each model card and clear _estimated when confirmed.

moonshotai/kimi-k2.5.reasoningSafeReason: K2.5 emits tool calls in a format that the openclaw harness can't round-trip when reasoning=true; agent loops on empty toolUse stops. See project_chad_cron_pattern memory.
moonshotai/kimi-k2.5._deprecated: Removed from NVIDIA Endpoints catalog 2026-04-29 (returns 410 GONE on inference). Upstream NemoClaw PR #2735 dropped it from CLOUD_MODEL_OPTIONS. Entry retained for historical task-profiles inheritance comments.

nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b._note: Cheap-tier cloud model since 2026-04-30 (replacing the deprecated Kimi K2.5). MoE: ~120B total / ~12B active. Hosted on integrate.api.nvidia.com via the NVIDIA_API_KEY. Fast; used for single-turn cron/draft work.

nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b.reasoningSafeReason: VERIFIED 2026-06-13: with reasoning ON (system 'detailed thinking on') Ultra emits a STANDARD OpenAI tool_call with valid-JSON args and completes a 2-turn round-trip (finish_reason=stop, answer reflected the tool result) against integrate.api.nvidia.com. This is the exact round-trip Kimi K2.5 failed (K2.5 used a non-standard tool-call format) — Ultra does not have that defect. Test: scripts/chad-smithers/ harness-retest, results in docs/design/smithers-moshi-integration.md §harness-retest.
nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b._note: Newest + most capable NVIDIA open model (released 2026-06-04, Computex). 550B total / ~55B active, hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE built for long-running autonomous agents (orchestration, coding, deep research). Hosted on integrate.api.nvidia.com via NVIDIA_API_KEY, OpenAI-compatible, free. Capable-tier default for the Smithers router (scripts/chad-smithers).

google/gemma-3-4b._note: Local fallback, Jetson-class. Ceiling for cron tasks running offline.

claude-opus-4-7._note: Premium endpoint. Hits Anthropic Messages API directly. Routed via chad-premium-client; access gated by chad-auth-context (dashboard senderId, terminal token, tantodefi@proton.me sender, or @supachad mention).

claude-sonnet-4-6._note: Default premium model for /premium and chad-premium. Cheaper than Opus, still frontier-grade reasoning.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001._note: Used by chad-premium-client --probe for cheap connectivity check.

meta/llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct._note: Llama 4 supports a very large context upstream (≫131072); conservative serve-side estimate used until verified.

moonshotai/kimi-k2.6._note: Successor to the deprecated K2.5. Assumed reasoningSafe under Smithers' own tool loop (NOT the openclaw harness that K2.5 broke); verify before any openclaw-side use.

unknownModel._note: Conservative fallback for any model not explicitly listed — preflight/clamp use this so an unknown id is still bounded.
